conjecture: Bare MONOIDS for the Dirichlet tensor in Poly (no ◁ structure) are exactly: a monoid structure (·, e) on the shape set S together with an OPLAX MONOIDAL FUNCTOR P: (S,·,e) → (Set,×) — i.e. maps φ_{s,s'}: P(s·s') → P(s)×P(s') and ε: P(e) → 1 satisfying oplax coherence (associativity + unit). This is the dual of the ⊗-comonoid classification (families of monoids). Answers the Poly/⊗ slice of the DUAL to Niu–Spivak Ch9 Q5 = the ⊗-monoids flagged as future work in Remark 3.78.
note: PROVED 2026-07-19 (analytic unwinding in container coordinates). Dual/sibling of bare-dirichlet-comonoid (proved). A ⊗-monoid μ:c⊗c→c decomposes as forward m:S×S→S (shape multiplication) + backward φ_{s,s'}:c[m(s,s')]→c[s]×c[s'] (position oplax structure); unit η:y→c picks e∈S with ε:c[e]→1 (forced, unique). SHAPE parts of the assoc+unit laws ⟺ (S,m,e) a monoid; FIBRE parts ⟺ {φ,ε} an oplax monoidal functor (S,·,e)→(Set,×,1). §5 explains the comonoid↔monoid asymmetry (comult maps INTO S×S ⟹ diagonal forced; mult maps OUT OF S×S ⟹ any monoid). Uniform Thm B: ×-monoid = monoid on S with c[e]=∅ + oplax functor into (Set,⊔,∅) — same theorem, fibre target (Set,×,1)↦(Set,⊔,∅). When S=1 the oplax functor is a comonoid in (Set,×) = diagonal, so the single-shape ⊗-monoid is UNIQUE. Proof: proofs/2026-07-19-dirichlet-monoid-classification.md; two independent enumerations agree (c6_oplax.py, times_monoid.py). Novelty gate 07-18: ORTHOGONAL to De Pascalis–Uustalu–Veltrì 2509.25879 (◁-monoids, not ⊗); Niu–Spivak Rmk 3.78 flags ⊗-monoids as future work. CAUTION: same group plans other-tensor monoids — share promptly; frame as 'elementary answer to a future-work item'.
